1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Ship state
12:   const ship = {
13:     x: width / 2,
14:     y: height / 2,
15:     angle: 0,
16:     vx: 0,
17:     vy: 0,
18:     radius: 10,
19:     thrust: false,
20:     rotateDir: 0, // -1 left, 1 right
21:   };
22: 
23:   // Asteroid list
24:   const asteroids = [];
25:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 2000; // ms
26:   const lastSpawn = { time: 0 };
27:   // Background stars for visual depth
28:   const stars = [];
29:   const starCount = 100;
30:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
31:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
32:   }
33: 
34:   // Input handling
35:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false, ArrowUp: false };
36:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
37:     if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true;
38:   });
39:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
40:     if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false;
41:   });
42: 
43:   function spawnAsteroid() {
44:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
45:     let x, y, vx, vy;
46:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
47:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
48:     switch (edge) {
49:       case 0: // top
50:         x = Math.random() * width; y = -size; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = speed; break;
51:       case 1: // right
52:         x = width + size; y = Math.random() * height; vx = -speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; break;
53:       case 2: // bottom
54:         x = Math.random() * width; y = height + size; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; vy = -speed; break;
55:       case 3: // left
56:         x = -size; y = Math.random() * height; vx = speed; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * speed; break;
57:     }
58:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius: size });
59:   }
60: 
61:   function update(dt) {
62:     // Ship controls
63:     ship.rotateDir = 0;
64:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.rotateDir = -1;
65:     else if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.rotateDir = 1;
66:     ship.angle += ship.rotateDir * 0.005 * dt; // rotate speed
67:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
68:       const thrustPower = 0.001 * dt;
69:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrustPower;
70:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrustPower;
71:     }
72:     // Apply velocity
73:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
74:     ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
75: 
76:     // Lose if off-screen
77:     if (ship.x < 0 || ship.x > width || ship.y < 0 || ship.y > height) {
78:       gameOver();
79:     }
80: 
81:     // Update asteroids
82:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
83:       const a = asteroids[i];
84:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
85:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
86:       // Remove if far off-screen
87:       if (a.x < -50 || a.x > width + 50 || a.y < -50 || a.y > height + 50) {
88:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
89:         continue;
90:       }
91:       // Collision with ship
92:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
93:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
94:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
95:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) {
96:         gameOver();
97:       }
98:     }
99: 
100:     // Spawn asteroids
101:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn.time > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
102:       spawnAsteroid();
103:       lastSpawn.time = performance.now();
104:     }
105:   }
106: 
107:   function draw() {
108:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
109:     // Draw ship (triangle) with optional thrust flame
110:     ctx.save();
111:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
112:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
113:     // Ship body
114:     ctx.beginPath();
115:     ctx.moveTo(ship.radius, 0);
116:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, ship.radius / 2);
117:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, -ship.radius / 2);
118:     ctx.closePath();
119:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -ship.radius, 0, ship.radius);
120:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
121:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#060');
122:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
123:     ctx.fill();
124:     // Thrust flame when accelerating
125:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
126:       ctx.beginPath();
127:       ctx.moveTo(-ship.radius, ship.radius / 4);
128:       ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius - ship.radius, 0);
129:       ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius, -ship.radius / 4);
130:       ctx.closePath();
131:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
132:       ctx.fill();
133:     }
134:     ctx.restore();
135:     // Draw asteroids
136:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
137:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
138:       ctx.beginPath();
139:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
140:       ctx.fill();
141:     });
142:   }
143: 
144:   let lastTime = performance.now();
145:   let running = true;
146:   function loop() {
147:     if (!running) return;
148:     const now = performance.now();
149:     const dt = now - lastTime;
150:     lastTime = now;
151:     update(dt);
152:     draw();
153:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
154:   }
155:   function gameOver() {
156:     running = false;
157:     alert('Game Over');
158:   }
159: 
160:   // Start loop
161:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
162: })();

(End of file - total 162 lines)
